gate.sdkSourceScope: Complete sdk include tree consumed by the imported native SDK; prebuilt DLL, CLI, import library and modules are frozen separately. Runtime engine source is not rebuilt.
gate.providerInference: Synthetic fixtures only; no live model key used

scope: Backend model-dispatch interruption retains a fixed backend-observed failure code in its atomic uncertainty event
verified: Backend-only typed codes cover cancelled, deadline, provider_failure and dispatch_error; default unknown preserves the prior uncertainty shape
Actual product provider HTTP failure records provider_failure before child physical retirement
Receipt contains only generation, attempt identity and fixed failure_code, without provider exception text
Invalid enum rejected before mutation; repeat interruption preserves the original cause/event count
Uncertainty, model charge, prior history and exact post-exit retirement remain retained
Independent controlled peer verifies exactly 45 intentional requests
limitations: New cause-specific actual assertion covers provider_failure; this is not exhaustive validation of every classifier branch
Failure category is an observed dispatch fact, not proof of a complete provider outcome or authority for child-selected terminal reasons
AgentService/GraphService supervisor integration and broader worker capabilities remain open
No new full-native-suite, installation, hosted, live-provider or rendered-client acceptance claim
